messages:
ops-bot: Heads-up: NA-ORD2 will open a limited preview for the new Aurora-L80T Dedicated compact pools (8x 64GB) starting Mon 2026-07-06 09:00 CDT. Pilot + policy notes below. :sparkles:
vivian: (product) Pilot is invite-only. Target: high-throughput RLHF and long-context chat workloads. We expect tight memory packing use-cases to benefit most.
omar: (infra) Hardware note: Aurora-L80T has dense interconnect with 4:1 aggregate bandwidth. We've added a memory-striping allocator and NVLink-aware placement. Benchmarks: ~11-16% throughput uplift on mixed-batch scenarios.
keisha: (ops) New policy for pilot: introduce "burst credits" for shared-burst pools in ORD2. Each org gets a small bucket of burst credits to use shared capacity without immediately paying on-demand rates. Purpose: reduce friction during pilot testing.
billing-bot: Billing (internal): burst credits are consumed before on-demand billing; credits do not reduce reserved commitment obligations. Credits roll off after 30 days. Full accounting in runbook.
infra: config snippet for ops:
```
pool: na-ord2-aurora-l80t-preview
node_type: aurora-l80t
mode: compact
priority_window_secs: 172800  # 48h
fairshare: reserved=240, shared=80
burst_credits_per_org: 10
burst_credit_expiry_days: 30
alerts: capacity.aurora.burst_spill
```
keisha: scheduling: for first 48h we bias scheduling to reserved tenants to validate latency SLO. After priority window, shared-burst + burst credits will be used to soak test.
oncall-bot: Oncall note: add alert capacity.aurora.burst_spill to NA rotation for pilot. If spill > 10% sustained for 10m, page oncall.
sales-bot: Sales will contact selected accounts with pilot invites and a 30-day assessment addendum. Capacity requests go through the Capacity Request Form in the runbook.
vivian: CS action: notify invited customers and include guidance on burst credits and how they interact with reservations.
ops-bot: Docs & runbook (internal): https://intra.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/aurora-l80t-ord2-preview - internal only. Please report regressions in #eng-runtime and tag @omar/@keisha. :eyes:
